test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

One must adopt a life of self-control.

options.text: A life of self-control was adopted by one.
A life of self-control must be adopted by one
A life of self-control will be adopted by one.
A life of self-control has adopted by one.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**A life of self-control must be adopted by one.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence "One must adopt a life of self-control" is in the active voice.
 
• To convert it into passive voice, you need to restructure it to emphasize the action on the object rather than the doer of the action.
 
• In the passive voice sentence, "**A life of self-control**" becomes the subject. This is the entity that is receiving the action, and it has become the focus of the sentence.
 
• The verb "**must be adopted**" is in the passive voice. "Must be adopted" is the passive construction of "**must adopt**" from the active voice sentence.
 
• In passive voice sentences, the doer of the action (the agent) is often optional or omitted.
 
• In this case, "**by one**" is included to indicate who is responsible for adopting the life of self-control. "By one" serves as the agent in the passive construction.
 
• **Passive Voice**: *A life of self-control must be adopted by one.*

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
